alt: Decision Recheck: four optional LLM roles, one reviewable decision. Before tasks, the requirements researcher prioritizes source-review planning. After evaluation, the offer and support analyst prioritizes comparisons and follow-ups; the evidence reviewer prioritizes recorded decisions and scope; and the report writer arranges application-owned explanations. Browser tasks run deterministically without model narration. The application preserves recorded decisions.

Decision Recheck's decision-consistency boundary: a recorded fails result remains fails in the rendered report. Models select allowed IDs from an application-owned catalog; the application rebuilds report text from evidence records. Verify behavior before changing factual documentation. Invalid or incomplete selections are rejected, with partial work visible. Consistency does not establish source truth.

Real LLM validation, November 15, 2026: OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini returned eight fresh responses, four for a baseline and four for a recheck, using public HTTPX Introduction and QuickStart documentation. The full local suite passed 335 tests with zero skipped on Windows and Chrome. The browser task checked three text assertions; HTTPX runtime behavior, support service and human usability were not tested. The public demo is fictional and key-free; real site checks and optional live model calls run locally. Demo: decision-recheck.vercel.app. Source: github.com/ufodia/decision-recheck. Support: buymeacoffee.com/ufodia.
